milestones.name: Save Zote in Greenpath
milestones.note: Knight can choose to save Zote from a Vengefly King on the path leading to Greenpath. If not saved before acquiring Mantis Claw, Zote dies.

milestones.name: Neglect achievement
milestones.note: Granted by hitting Zote's shell after he dies (if not saved before acquiring Mantis Claw).

milestones.name: Rivalry achievement
milestones.note: Granted by beating Zote as the final boss of the first Colosseum of Fools trial.

milestones.name: Enter Greenpath
milestones.note: Area west of the Forgotten Crossroads with lush vegetation, pools of burning acid, and thick overgrowth.

zones.name: Greenpath
zones.fingerprintHint: Lush vegetation, leafy bug species, pools of burning acid, thick overgrowth; west of Forgotten Crossroads.
zones.note: Contains Lake of Unn and Stone Sanctuary sub-areas.

zones.name: Lake of Unn
zones.fingerprintHint: Sub-area of Greenpath, associated with Unn.

zones.name: Forgotten Crossroads
zones.fingerprintHint: Connected to Greenpath to the east.
zones.note: Greenpath is described as west of the Forgotten Crossroads.

zones.name: Fog Canyon
zones.note: Listed as a connection to Greenpath.

zones.name: Howling Cliffs
zones.note: Listed as a connection to Greenpath.

zones.name: Queen's Gardens
zones.note: Listed as a connection to Greenpath.

zones.name: Dirtmouth
zones.fingerprintHint: Town above Hallownest; Zote appears here after being saved.
zones.note: Zote travels here after being saved in Greenpath.

zones.name: City of Tears
zones.fingerprintHint: Zote found in a corridor leading back to its storerooms.
zones.note: Zote can be found here after Greenpath encounter.

zones.name: Deepnest
zones.fingerprintHint: Zote found stuck in spider webs here.
zones.note: Zote is found trapped in spider webs, captured by Deepnest beasts.

zones.name: Colosseum of Fools
zones.fingerprintHint: Zote is found in the resting area and becomes the final boss of the first trial.
zones.note: Zote becomes the final boss of the first trial here if saved both prior times.

bosses.name: Vengefly King
bosses.note: Holds Zote captive on the path leading to Greenpath. Knight can choose to fight and save Zote or leave.

bosses.name: Zote
bosses.note: Final boss of the first Colosseum trial. Deals no damage due to shellwood nail. Must be attacked until the fight ends. Beating him grants the Rivalry achievement. Only appears if Knight saved him in both Greenpath and Deepnest.

objectives.name: Rescue Zote from the Vengefly King
objectives.hopDescription: Fight the Vengefly King holding Zote captive on the path leading into Greenpath.
objectives.note: Optional — leaving Zote leads to his death if player acquires Mantis Claw first.

objectives.name: Reach Greenpath
objectives.hopDescription: Travel west from the Forgotten Crossroads to enter Greenpath.

connectors.description: Greenpath is located west of the Forgotten Crossroads.
